parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the network instance to query.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the network instance belongs.

parameters.name: EnabledIpv6
parameters.description:
Specifies whether IPv6 is enabled:
1. This parameter takes effect only when ProductType is set to "VPC".
2. A value of true indicates that IPv6 is enabled. A value of false indicates that IPv6 is not enabled. If this parameter is left empty, results are not filtered by this parameter.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
- If you do not specify the **MaxResults** parameter, you do not need to query results in batches. The **MaxResults** value in the response indicates the total number of entries.
- If you specify the **MaxResults** parameter, you need to query results in batches. The **MaxResults** value specifies the number of entries to return per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. The **MaxResults** value in the response indicates the number of entries in the current batch. We recommend that you set **MaxResults** to **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent request exists.
- If a subsequent request exists, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.

- **VBR**: virtual border router (VBR) instance.

- **CCN**: Cloud Connect Network instance.

- **VPN**: IPsec connection.

- **ECR**: Express Connect Router (ECR) instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the network instance.                   

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query region IDs.
